shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat/rounded surface
justification: Both depict human figures rendered in shallow relief and both include a prominent circular disc motif (a chariot wheel in A, a raised ring on the torso in B), but these are generic forms arrived at independently. A shows a narrative horizontal battle scene with archers in a wheeled chariot and horses trampling a fallen enemy, while B is a single frontal, static anthropomorphic figure with a schematic head, arms and body-borne ornaments — utterly different subjects, compositions and conventions.
